title: Email
secureHelp: Web settings require TLS or STARTTLS. Explicitly select a secure mode if the file uses plaintext.
help: Manage saved SMTP and read-only IMAP settings. Passwords are write-only; drafts stay in this page only.
resetConfirm: Restore file defaults? Unsaved changes will be discarded.
failed: The request failed. Refresh the saved state before another attempt.
conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Refresh and review before saving.
unknown: Outcome unknown. Do not resend automatically; inspect delivery history using the operation ID.
reconfirm: I approve retaining this password for the selected server and account.
globalHelp: Announcement mail requires an explicit admin request. Resource alerts require both the global switch and user opt-in; past events are not mailed.
preferencesHelp: Choose announcement and supported resource alert emails. Global policy and current access still apply. Explicit individual admin messages are independent of these preferences.
rejected: The request was rejected. Review the inputs and permissions before submitting again.
audiencePending: Recipients will be resolved from the current audience and access when the announcement becomes active. The recipient count is not yet known.
checkHelp: Checks use the saved configuration, not unsaved fields. No email is sent.
receiptHelp: Receipt checking is read-only and only available for test messages. It searches the saved IMAP mailbox for the exact Message-ID.
subject: Subject
registeredHelp: Only the immutable selected user ID is submitted. The server resolves the current registered mailbox; editing this profile does not change this recipient.
queued: Queued for delivery. Refresh history for per-recipient outcomes.
proof: Accepted means SMTP acceptance only, not inbox receipt. Only confirmed IMAP observation proves receipt in the configured mailbox.
schedule: Mail waits until the announcement starts, and never sends after expiry or while inactive. Audience and access are revalidated at dispatch.
noMailbox: An enabled user with a registered mailbox is required.
